details:
Shield levels do this already, but to save time and sanity and deter trolls, maybe there should be a per-account/per-trust level amount of features one has access to.

People easily make alt accounts and will do everything in their power to be disruptive, many groups kicks visitors on sight because they have access to disruptive avatars which newer players might not instantly cull with shield levels.

So it's sort of visitor on visitor violence, where one visitor is a troll and the other a genuine new player who doesn't know much of what they're doing, and who's experience is poor/abysmal because of trolls. 

Maybe visitors shouldn't have access to certain features in public instances, such as avatar audio, shaders, particles, maybe even avatar sizes etc.

Earning trust levels could slowly unlock those features (as they're becoming more "trustworthy" (and ofc the shield settings can still be used by others to cull features even if they unlock them).

Buying VR+/getting verified already raises trust levels so this could also work as an incentive to get vr+ as it would get visitors into a better trust level more quickly. Gatekeeping these features would drive vr+ sales up (hopefully) while also making it harder/more annoying for trolls to start over with new accounts.

Not gonna fix the problem, but will make it more annoying for trolls which is a win in my book.

Also, as I was only a month ago a visitor myself, I can 100% confirm that not having shaders, particles or avatar sounds as a visitor would not have made any difference in my experience. I never once wondered about particle, or needed to be 500 meters tall.
title: Progressive game features based on trust level
